import random, json
random.seed(0)
def roman(n):
    vals=[(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]
    s=''
    for v,c in vals:
        while n>=v: s+=c; n-=v
    return s
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    a,b,n=random.sample(range(1,40),3)
    items.append({"prompt":f"Convert to Roman numerals.\n{a} = {roman(a)}\n{b} = {roman(b)}\n{n} =","answer":" "+roman(n)})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Copy the number.\n{a} = {a}\n{b} = {b}\n{n} =","answer":f" {n}"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))

import torch, json
ids=json.load(open('/work/cats.json'))
E=W('model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight'); LM=W('lm_head.weight'); nw=W('model.language_model.norm.weight')
def rms(x): return x/ x.pow(2).mean(-1,keepdim=True).sqrt()
for cat in ['weekday','month','numword','color','ordinal']:
    t=ids[cat]; n=len(t)
    X=rms(E[t])
    U=LM[t]*nw
    out=[]
    for L in [3,7,11,15,19,23,27,31]:
        p=f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.'
        ln=W(p+'input_layernorm.weight')
        V=W(p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight'); O=W(p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight')
        nh=O.shape[1]//256; nkv=V.shape[0]//256
        for h in range(nh):
            kv=h//(nh//nkv)
            v=(X*ln)@V[kv*256:(kv+1)*256].T
            o=v@O[:,h*256:(h+1)*256].T
            S=o@U.T  # n x n
            S=S-S.mean(1,keepdim=True)
            diag=S.diag().mean().item()
            succ=torch.stack([S[i,(i+1)%n] for i in range(n)]).mean().item()
            sd=S.std().item()
            out.append((succ/sd,diag/sd,L,h))
    out.sort(reverse=True)
    print(cat,'succ',[(round(a,2),round(b,2),L,h) for a,b,L,h in out[:4]])
    out.sort(key=lambda r:-r[1]); print(cat,'copy',[(round(a,2),round(b,2),L,h) for a,b,L,h in out[:4]])
